g.text: High power solenoid drivers (sol. 1-8): IRLR3110Z DPAK (100 V, 14 mOhm, 16 mOhm at 4.5 V) driven directly by latch U5 (74HCT574, output HIGH = ON,

g.desc: High power solenoid drivers (sol. 1-8): IRLR3110Z DPAK (100 V, 14 mOhm, 16 mOhm at 4.5 V) driven directly by latch U5 (74HCT574, output HIGH = ON,

g.text: outputs tri-stated by BLANKING -> gate pull-downs hold every driver OFF). SMC 3 A tie-back diodes return to +50V (the "+50V" rail of a WPC

g.desc: outputs tri-stated by BLANKING -> gate pull-downs hold every driver OFF). SMC 3 A tie-back diodes return to +50V (the "+50V" rail of a WPC

g.text: machine is ~70 V DC: 51 VAC winding, 72-78 V peak). U5 is clocked by /SOL 4 (J113-10). Output connectors J130 (playfield, key pin 3), J132 (backbox, sol 1-4, key 4)

g.desc: machine is ~70 V DC: 51 VAC winding, 72-78 V peak). U5 is clocked by /SOL 4 (J113-10). Output connectors J130 (playfield, key pin 3), J132 (backbox, sol 1-4, key 4)

g.text: and J131 (cabinet, sol 5-8, key 2) as on the A-12697. Supply +50V via F105 on J107-3.
